settings.title: "To simplify the revenue cycle for healthcare providers, from insurance claims to patient payments, so they can focus on patient care."
Technology experience backed by Corvit & StelleCloud

settings.editor: Parent group founded in 2000, delivering enterprise technology, cybersecurity, and solutions nationwide.
The four foundational operational promises that guide every client partnership at StelleMed.
Real-time 270/271 electronic checks confirm patient coverage and copays before service delivery.
Rapid clean-claim scrubbing and EDI clearinghouse dispatch to shorten days in accounts receivable.
Immediate reconciliation and posting of electronic remittance advices (ERAs) and patient copays.
Comprehensive executive meetings with your dedicated account manager analyzing financial KPIs.

StelleMed is backed by StelleCloud and Corvit, an IT training and solutions company founded in 2000 that has trained more than 350,000 professionals. Through them, our group works with leading technology and business organizations.
